description: An open-source cloud-and-edge lifecycle workbench for designing, building, and operating hardware and software products, guided by a shared semantic graph and human-in-the-loop AI agents.

texts.diagrams: how the cloud portal, the bench edge and the semantic graph work together through the Observe, Design, Build, Run loop, and the decisions that needed a picture
texts.ontology_scope: The T-Box only: it defines hardware blocks with their pins and wires, interfaces, software modules, articles and provenance records, and how they relate. It holds no product's data. Each workspace's A-Box, the actual products and their parts, lives in Maker-5 and is never published here.
texts.borrowed: Terms from OSLC SysML v2, W3C PROV-O and SPDX, and what they mean in Maker-5.
texts.shapes: The validation gates: what the cloud checks on every save of an A-Box, including an agent's proposal. A save that breaks one is refused with the message shown.
